title: Te Wairua Mamae o te Naera
intro: I te wā o te tukino nui, i te wā i whakahaerea ai te whenua e te kaitukino me te nanakia rawa, kotahi te wairua i whiriwhiri i te ara o te whakapono, kaua te whakamarie o te rangatiratanga. I noho tēnei tangata i roto i te ngākau o te mana, engari i kitea te pono i roto i te karere a te poropiti whakaiti. Ka waiho tā rātou haerenga hei akoranga mutunga kore mō te manawanui, te patunga tapu, me te whakapono pumau. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata whakamiharo i pai ake ki te ahuareka o te Atua i te mana o te ao?
clues: I noho ahau i roto i te whare rangatira nui, heoi i kitea e tōku ngākau te pono i roto i tētahi karere whakaiti.
I whiriwhiria e au te whai i ngā tohutohu a Mōsa, me te mōhio ki ngā hua ka pā ki ahau.
I marenatia ahau ki te rangatira whakakeke tino kaha o tōku wā, heoi i whakakahoretia e ahau ana atua teka.
Nui atu te mamae i pā mai ki ahau, i whiua hoki ahau mō taku whakapono ki te Atua Kotahi.
Kāore au i ruarua i roto i tōku whakapono, ahakoa te wā i pāngia ai ahau e te whakamamae tino kino.
I koa tōku Ariki ki tōku manawanui, ā, i whiriwhiria ahau e ia mō tētahi wāhi honore i Pararaiha.

outcome.answer: I whakamatea, ā, i whakahonoretia e Allah

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
